name: WebdriverIO
summary: A Node.js automation framework on the WebDriver and WebDriver BiDi protocols that drives browsers and, through Appium, native mobile apps.
strengths: One TypeScript framework for web and native mobile (via Appium).
Standards-based protocols work with every major browser and cloud grid.
Rich plugin ecosystem: Cucumber, Allure, visual and accessibility services.
tradeoffs: More configuration than Playwright or Cypress before the first test runs.
Real-device and grid runs are slower than local browser automation.
